## `add_eqs_generator`

*Destructive.*

Adds a UEnvQueryGenerator subclass to a UEnvQuery option. If the option has no generator yet, this becomes it; otherwise replaces. option_index names an existing option, or equals the option count to append one new empty option; a negative option_index, or one past the option count, is an error checked before anything changes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `generator_class` | string | yes | Generator class name (e.g. "ActorsOfClass", "SimpleGrid", "PathingGrid") or full path (e.g. "/Script/AIModule.EnvQueryGenerator_ActorsOfClass") |
| `option_index` | number | no | Optional option index to target (default 0); the current option count appends a new option, a larger index is refused |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, option_index, generator_class, generator_name, replaced, saved }`

## `add_eqs_option`

## `add_eqs_test`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Add a test of test_class to an option of a UEnvQuery asset, after the option's existing tests. Idempotent per class: if the option already has a test of that class, that one is returned (already_existed=true) and nothing is added, so an option holds at most one test per class. option_index names an existing option, or equals the option count to append one new empty option; a negative option_index, or one past the option count, is an error checked before anything changes. Undoable as one editor transaction; marks the asset dirty without saving (save_asset). Valid classes: list_eqs_test_types; configure the test with set_eqs_test_scoring; remove_eqs_test is the inverse.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `test_class` | string | yes | Test class name (e.g. "Distance", "Trace", "Pathfinding", "Dot") or full path |
| `option_index` | number | no | Optional option index to target (default 0); the current option count appends a new option, a larger index is refused |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, option_index, test_class, test_name, test_index, test_count, already_existed } — idempotent by test class within the option`

## `diagnose_navmesh`

*Read-only.*

One-call navmesh diagnosis: reports every ANavMeshBoundsVolume (brush validity + world extent — detects the EMPTY brush = 0 bounds that yields 0 tiles), inclusion/total nav bounds, bWholeWorldNavigable, invoker-only generation + registered invokers, the RecastNavMesh MaxTiles / built (active) tile count / RuntimeGeneration, and is_spatially_loaded per volume, plus an actionable `diagnosis` list. Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `world` | string | no | Optional world selector: absent/'editor' (default) \| 'server' (**the one you want in PIE**: the navmesh is SERVER-AUTHORITATIVE, so only the authoritative world has a nav system and a RecastNavMesh) \| 'pie' (ambiguous: PlayWorld, else the first PIE context -- may well land on the CLIENT) \| 'client' \| 'pie:N' \| 'game' (alias of 'pie'). |

**Returns:** `` { world, has_authority, nav_system_present, whole_world_navigable, generate_only_around_invokers, supported_agent_count, nav_data_count, is_navigation_dirty, nav_bounds_volume_count, nav_bounds_volumes:[{actor_name, actor_label, is_spatially_loaded, brush_present, brush_empty, bounds_valid, bounds_extent:{x,y,z}, brush_poly_count, note}], registered_nav_bounds_count, total_nav_bounds:{valid, min:{x,y,z}, max:{x,y,z}, extent:{x,y,z}}, invoker_component_count, invoker_location_count, invoker_seed_bounds_count, recast_navmesh_present, recast:{name, runtime_generation, supports_runtime_generation, max_tiles, active_tile_count, tile_size_uu, is_spatially_loaded}, diagnosis:[string], success, world_name, world_package, world_type, net_mode, pie_instance }. On a CLIENT world (has_authority=false) the heuristics are suppressed and `diagnosis` says so first: a client with no nav system / no RecastNavMesh is EXPECTED, and rebuild_navigation is NEVER recommended from there. ``

## `diff_collision_channels`

*Read-only.*

Aligns this project's custom collision channels with another project's config BY NAME and reports index shifts (which ECC_GameTraceChannelN slot / TraceTypeQueryN a same-named channel moved to). Diagnoses the migration hazard where custom channels don't travel and traces silently stop hitting. Reads the other project's DefaultEngine.ini straight from disk (not loaded). Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `other_project_config_dir` | string | yes | Path to the OTHER project's Config directory (containing DefaultEngine.ini); the project root also works (Config/DefaultEngine.ini is tried as a fallback) |

**Returns:** `{ other_ini_path, other_ini_found, aligned_by, this_channel_count, other_channel_count, shifted_count, matched:[{name, is_trace_type, channel_this, channel_other, channel_shifted, query_this, query_other, query_shifted}], only_in_this:[{name, channel, query_type}], only_in_other:[{name, channel, query_type}], success }`

## `dump_collision_channels`

*Read-only.*

Dumps this project's custom collision channels (from config): each ECC_GameTraceChannelN / object channel -> friendly name, whether it's a trace or object channel, and its TraceTypeQueryN / ObjectTypeQueryN index (the value a raycast/overlap passes). Read-only. Read from GConfig [/Script/Engine.CollisionProfile] DefaultChannelResponses.

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ source, builtin_trace_count, builtin_object_count, count, channels:[{channel, channel_value, name, is_trace_type, is_static_object, is_custom_game_slot, default_response, query_type, query_index, query_number}], success }`

## `remove_eqs_generator`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Clears the generator on a query option. Idempotent (removed=false if the option had none).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `option_index` | number | no | Option index (default 0) |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, option_index, removed }`

## `remove_eqs_option`

*Destructive.*

Remove the option at option_index, with its generator and tests, from a UEnvQuery asset; later options shift down one index. Marks the asset dirty without saving (use save_asset); an out-of-range index is an error, not a no-op. Returns removed and option_count.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `option_index` | number | yes | Index of the option to remove (required) |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, option_index, removed, option_count }`

## `remove_eqs_test`

*Destructive.*

Remove the test at test_index from one option of a UEnvQuery asset; later tests shift down one index. Marks the asset dirty without saving (use save_asset); an out-of-range option or test index is an error, not a no-op. Returns removed and test_count.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `test_index` | number | yes | Index of the test to remove within the option (required) |
| `option_index` | number | no | 0-based index of the query option that holds the test (default 0). |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, option_index, test_index, removed, test_count }`

## `run_eqs_query`

*Destructive.*

Runs a UEnvQuery synchronously against the editor world (UEnvQueryManager::RunInstantQuery) and returns the scored items. Generators/tests needing navigation data (SimpleGrid/PathingGrid/Pathfinding/Project/Trace) require a built navmesh; without it the query returns a non-Success status honestly (still success:true, ran:true).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `querier_actor` | string | no | Optional actor display label or name used as the query Querier (drives contexts like EnvQueryContext_Querier); default: the query asset (no location) |
| `run_mode` | string | no | "SingleResult" \| "RandomBest5Pct" \| "RandomBest25Pct" \| "AllMatching" (default "AllMatching") |
| `max_items` | number | no | Optional cap on how many items are serialized into the payload (default 50; the query still evaluates all) |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, ran, eqs_manager_present, status, is_successful, num_items, item_type, run_mode, items:[{index, score, location:{x,y,z}, actor?}], note? }`

## `set_eqs_generator_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets properties on an option's generator by reflection (mcp_common::SetObjectProperty). Class-ref props (SearchedActorClass, SearchCenter) take a class path string; FAIDataProvider*Value props (SearchRadius, GenerateOnlyActorsInRadius) take an object like {"DefaultValue": &lt;n>}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `properties` | object | yes | JSON object { PropertyName: value, ... } applied to the generator |
| `option_index` | number | no | Option index whose generator is edited (default 0) |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, option_index, generator_class, set:[name], failed:[{name, error}], applied:{name: stored_value_text} }`

## `set_eqs_test_scoring`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets scoring/filter parameters on a test within a query option and PERSISTS them on the asset (TestPurpose, FilterType, ScoringEquation, ScoringFactor, FloatValue bounds are all real UEnvQueryTest UPROPERTYs). The response reports the values read back from the test object.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query_path` | string | yes | /Game/... path to the UEnvQuery asset (required) |
| `option_index` | number | no | Option index (default 0) |
| `test_index` | number | no | Test index within the option (default 0) |
| `test_purpose` | string | no | "Filter" \| "Score" \| "FilterAndScore" (default "Score") |
| `filter_type` | string | no | "Minimum" \| "Maximum" \| "Range" \| "Match" (default "Range") |
| `scoring_equation` | string | no | "Linear" \| "Square" \| "InverseLinear" \| "SquareRoot" \| "Constant" (default "Linear") |
| `scoring_factor` | number | no | Optional weight multiplier applied after the equation (ScoringFactor.DefaultValue); only applied when provided |
| `float_value_min` | number | no | Optional min for FloatValueMin (default 0) |
| `float_value_max` | number | no | Optional max for FloatValueMax (default 1) |

**Returns:** `{ query_path, option_index, test_index, test_name, test_purpose, filter_type, scoring_equation, scoring_factor, float_value_min, float_value_max }`

## `set_recast_navmesh_settings`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Configures generation settings on the editor world's default ARecastNavMesh (partial/idempotent; only provided params are applied and all numeric values are clamped server-side first).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_radius` | number | no | Optional float; ARecastNavMesh::AgentRadius (>= 0) |
| `agent_height` | number | no | Optional float; ARecastNavMesh::AgentHeight (>= 0) |
| `agent_max_slope` | number | no | Optional float degrees; ARecastNavMesh::AgentMaxSlope (clamped to &lt;= 89) |
| `agent_max_step_height` | number | no | Optional float; SetAgentMaxStepHeight(Default, v) (>= 0) |
| `tile_size_uu` | number | no | Optional float; ARecastNavMesh::TileSizeUU (clamped to >= 300) |
| `cell_size` | number | no | Optional float; SetCellSize(Default, v) (clamped 1..1024) |
| `cell_height` | number | no | Optional float; SetCellHeight(Default, v) (clamped 1..1024) |
| `merge_region_size` | number | no | Optional float; ARecastNavMesh::MergeRegionSize (>= 0) |
| `min_region_area` | number | no | Optional float; ARecastNavMesh::MinRegionArea (>= 0) |
| `max_simplification_error` | number | no | Optional float; ARecastNavMesh::MaxSimplificationError (>= 0) |
| `simplification_elevation_ratio` | number | no | Optional float; ARecastNavMesh::SimplificationElevationRatio (>= 0) |
| `rebuild` | boolean | no | Optional bool (default false); when true, calls UNavigationSystemV1::Build() synchronously to apply |

**Returns:** `{ recast_navmesh_present, navmesh_name, applied:{field:value}, requires_rebuild, rebuilt, note, success }`
